faq.title: Common questions
faq.a1: Yes. The core features, countdown, local kickoff time, 24h / 3h / 30min reminders, and following one national team, are free forever. No account, no subscription, no ads.
faq.q2: What does the Pro upgrade add?
faq.a2: Pro is a one-time payment of $9.90 (no subscription). It unlocks: following multiple teams with a full-tournament view, smart custom reminders, where-to-watch broadcaster links by country, and adding matches to Google Calendar or downloading an .ics file.
faq.q3: Do you collect my personal data?
faq.a3: No. PitchAlert stores only your selected team and reminder preferences locally on your device using Chrome's built-in storage. Nothing is sent to any server. No analytics, no tracking pixels, no third-party scripts, in the extension or on this website.
faq.a4: All 48 national teams competing in the 2026 FIFA World Cup, spanning six confederations, UEFA, CONMEBOL, CONCACAF, CAF, AFC, and OFC. The full match schedule is bundled inside the extension.
faq.a5: Yes. The complete World Cup 2026 schedule is bundled inside the extension package. PitchAlert makes no network requests and works fully offline, reminders fire from Chrome's local alarm scheduler.
faq.q6: How do I request a refund?
faq.a6: We honour a 30-day refund window for Pro purchases. Email us at tgparm973@gmail.com with your order number and we’ll process the refund promptly. See the full Refund Policy for details.
faq.q7: Chrome says "Proceed with caution", is that safe?
faq.a7: Yes. Chrome shows that notice for any newly published extension that hasn’t built up an install history yet with Enhanced Safe Browsing. It reflects our age in the store, not a security problem with the code. PitchAlert asks for only three permissions (alarms, notifications, storage), makes no network requests, and collects no data. Just click “Continue to install”, the notice fades as more people install over time.
